---
title: "Yes, We Have Patrick Colmer Speeches (for the ‘Merely Curious’)"
date: "2010-02-19"
categories: ["Economics", "Foreign Investment"]
---

Using Freedom of Information legislation, I have obtained a [copy of a speech](../../files/colmer.pdf "copy of a speech") given by Patrick Colmer, Executive Director of the Foreign Investment Review Board, to the Australian-China Investment Forum on 24 September last year.  The background to the speech and the FOI process are discussed in an [op-ed](http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/opinion/more-inscrutable-than-the-chinese/story-e6frg6zo-1225831954203 "op-ed") in today’s Australian.
